records.title: Translation services — Requirements for translation services
records.scope: Specifies requirements for all aspects of the translation process directly affecting quality and delivery, including translator/reviser qualifications and mandatory bilingual revision.
records.mandatory_or_voluntary: Voluntary standard (frequently contractually mandated in government and enterprise RFPs)
key_requirements: Translator graduate degree in translation OR degree + 2 yrs experience OR 5 yrs full-time professional experience
Documented pre-production, project management, and feedback processes
records.certification_mechanism: Third-party accredited certification audit (e.g., Austrian Standards, Bureau Veritas, TÜV) with annual surveillance audits.

records.title: Translation services — Post-editing of machine translation output — Requirements
records.scope: Defines requirements for the process of full and light human post-editing of machine translation output (MTPE) and post-editor competencies.
records.mandatory_or_voluntary: Voluntary (contractually referenced in enterprise MTPE SLAs)
key_requirements: Distinguishes Full Post-Editing (human-equivalent publishable quality) vs. Light Post-Editing (comprehensible/accurate)
Post-editors must meet ISO 17100 translator competence criteria plus specialized MTPE training
records.certification_mechanism: Third-party conformity assessment / audit alongside ISO 17100.

records.title: Translation services — Evaluation of translation output — General guidance
records.scope: Establishes harmonized principles for analytic error-typology evaluation of human, MTPE, and unedited translation output (aligned with MQM concepts).
key_requirements: Defines error categories (Accuracy, Linguistic conventions, Terminology, Style, Locale conventions, Design/Markup)
Pre-evaluation sampling, evaluator qualification, and score calculation
records.certification_mechanism: Guidance standard (implemented via LQA scorecards and TMS QA modules).

records.title: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) Framework
records.scope: Hierarchical analytic error typology and scoring framework for evaluating human, MT, and LLM translation quality.
key_requirements: 7 core dimensions: Terminology, Accuracy, Linguistic Conventions, Style, Locale Conventions, Audience Appropriateness, Design & Markup
Penalty weights per severity normalized per 1,000 words
records.certification_mechanism: Adopted directly in TMS platforms (Phrase, Smartling, RWS) and LLM evaluation benchmarks.

records.title: Tags for Identifying Languages (RFC 5646) & Common Locale Data Repository
records.scope: Global technical syntax for language/script/region tags (e.g., zh-Hans-CN, sr-Latn-RS, es-419) and locale formatting data (dates, plurals, currencies, collation).
records.mandatory_or_voluntary: Mandatory technical interoperability standard across all modern operating systems, browsers, and localization files
key_requirements: Subtag sequence: language-extlang-script-region-variant-extension-privateuse (ISO 639 + ISO 15924 + ISO 3166-1 / UN M.49)
CLDR plural category rules (zero, one, two, few, many, other)
records.certification_mechanism: Technical parser validation & ICU library conformance.

records.title: Medical Devices Quality Management Systems & EU Medical Device Regulation
records.scope: Quality management system for medical device design/production and legal mandate requiring device labels, IFUs, and software UI in up to 24 official EU member-state languages.
records.mandatory_or_voluntary: Legally mandatory for EU market access (CE marking) and quality-audited for medical suppliers
key_requirements: Documented traceability, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), version control, and verified translation accuracy prior to device distribution
records.certification_mechanism: Notified Body audit (CE mark) & ISO 13485 accredited certification.
